$description: Template kits: page patterns composed only of system components and semantic tokens. Check K1 keeps this list in step with src/patterns.

kits.title: Sign in
kits.summary: Sign-in and sign-up pages: a centered card with email, a password that can be revealed, a remember-me choice, single sign-on and a form-level error.

kits.title: Settings
kits.summary: A preferences page split into tabs, each a card-wrapped form with selects, radios, switches, a slider and a save bar.

kits.title: Data table
kits.summary: A list page: title and main action, search with a slash shortcut, a status filter, a selectable table, pagination, and loading and empty states.

kits.title: Dashboard
kits.summary: An overview page: a top bar, a page title with an action, view tabs, stat cards, a goal, a chart, recent activity and recent orders.

kits.title: Profile
kits.summary: An account page: breadcrumb, the person with avatar and role, an editable public profile and a list of connected services.

kits.title: Docs article
kits.summary: A long-form documentation page: contents sidebar, breadcrumb, typography for prose, a diagram, a code sample, a callout, a collapsible, an FAQ and previous/next links.

kits.title: Onboarding
kits.summary: First-run screens: a setup step with progress and choices, an empty workspace with next steps, and a setting-up wait state.

kits.title: Form states
kits.summary: A gallery of every form control in its default, disabled, invalid and read-only states, for checking tokens, focus rings and right to left in one place.
